# 1. Product and Scope

Purpose: freeze release behavior before final validation begins.

## Final steps

- [ ] Implement the accepted Free/Plus/Max subscription direction. Refine advanced Arete as
  the main Plus–Max differentiator, define measured usage allowances, and pass the readiness
  checks in [`SUBSCRIPTIONS_AND_PROMOTIONS.md`](product/SUBSCRIPTIONS_AND_PROMOTIONS.md#2-accepted-tier-direction-free-plus-and-max)
  before advertising Max's advanced capabilities.
- [ ] Choose current release number, target date, release owner, and submission scope.
- [ ] Reconcile that decision in [`PATHS_VERSION_ROADMAP.md`](product/PATHS_VERSION_ROADMAP.md) and
  this slate; create a version-specific sign-off artifact only when release number is locked.
- [ ] Confirm Groups remains outside current release navigation. Discord-hosted Groups stays
  deferred unless explicitly promoted into scope.
- [ ] Lock sign-up choices and copy. Current proposed direction: Sign in with Apple as primary,
  email as fallback, and Discord only when entering Discord-backed Groups.
- [ ] Decide referral arrival behavior: attribution only, or a disclosed friend request after
  signup. Current behavior records attribution only and creates no Paths contact.
- [ ] Provide an owned HTTPS invitation destination that survives installation and preserves
  the referral token. Current `paths://` links work only when Paths is installed.
- [ ] Expand avatar library to at least 10 usable assets per category for both male and female
  avatars. Inventory every category in `CustomizeAvatarMenu.allCategories`; count paired hair
  front/back artwork as one choice and do not count removal/none placeholders. Shared categories
  such as backgrounds need 10 shared choices rather than duplicated sex-specific copies.
- [ ] Validate every added avatar asset for artboard compatibility, layer order, thumbnail crop,
  color behavior, hat/hair interaction where applicable, persistence, and physical-device render.
- [ ] Redesign the avatar hat-fitting system. The user still considers the current ear-anchored
  result unfinished; keep this deferred until the fitting approach is revisited. Passing geometry
  and device tests does not establish visual acceptance. See `product/AVATAR_WORK_HANDOFF.md`.
- [x] Expand clothing with approximately three additional designs per archetype, each fitted to
  both original bodies. All fifteen designs are implemented as thirty SVGs. Both recent wardrobe
  waves use the visible original bases. The full 66-file consistency audit also corrected
  crossing seams, collar/apron joins, detail placement, and two original sports cuffs. All 330
  source color cases and 37 physical-device tests pass; native captures were reviewed and the
  app is installed in normal mode. See `Methods_Images/avatar-clothing-consistency/README.md`.
- [ ] Review remaining core product surfaces for unfinished, placeholder, or debug-only states.

## Exit condition

One named release has a dated, owner-approved scope. No validation depends on an unresolved
product choice.
